name: runshot
description: Snapshot what your command really did — local run capture with a beautiful timeline UI.

scripts.test:smoke: RUNSHOT_HOME=./.tmp-runshot node src/cli.js --no-open --no-server -- node -e "console.log('ok'); console.error('warn')" && RUNSHOT_HOME=./.tmp-runshot node src/cli.js list && RUNSHOT_HOME=./.tmp-runshot node src/cli.js report -o ./.tmp-runshot/report.html
